notes.title: Warborne 18-Hour Urgent War Report
notes.notes: [h3]Driftmasters![/h3][p]We hope your battles have been going smoothly during this time! Over the past day, Warborne has joined each of you in [b]conquering one achievement after another![/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]We've captured the top spots on Steam's Trending and Free charts, becoming a dual TOP1:[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/9aba87d15ccff7f35b498219a57284fe8b471231.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/67e7451ae89dedc1ff810bfc2bd96ba16b9a3f27.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]In the crowded categories of Free Popular, Player vs. Player, and MMO, Warborne has secured its place among the big hits:[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/c3b35405154a876625a0607b9541103bbb45fb9d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/06562dc25ba4c1d2a42f4ab88bc2cc4b0e067dd7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]On the Free Trending chart, we're way ahead of the pack:[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/687b811d5783e85d81c3bc7dcd1b034eca52f171.png"][/img][/p][h3]These victories belong to you![/h3][h3]To all the Driftmasters who've supported us all along![/h3][p]We started this game project with the philosophy of "fight to your heart's content," and we've met like-minded folks in all of you. Thanks to your support and passion for Warborne, we've achieved what we have today. There's no better way to repay you than by working even harder to deliver an even more exciting gaming experience![/p][p]With that in mind, rather than just sharing the good news, it's more important to address the issues you've raised: We've collected some of the most common concerns and feedback**. We must respond right away:**[/p][p][/p][h3][b]FAQ:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]1. Why are you opening servers by time zone? We're getting impatient![/b][/p][p]Because Warborne is a global game, and to ensure players in different time zones can all enjoy the most authentic battle fun during their peak hours, we have to open servers sequentially across the Asia-Europe-America regions to guarantee the best experience for everyone.[/p][p]Plus, we're opening each server at 10:00 AM in its local time zone, so you can fight from morning till night![/p][p][b]2. The servers are so unstable—when I try to enter, it says maintenance![/b][/p][p]I think it's because you selected the wrong star zone! As mentioned above, each region's opening times differ, so you might have accidentally drifted into a zone that hasn't opened yet.[/p][p][b]3. I can't open the auction house?[/b][/p][p]Opening the auction house requires some data loading time, so we suggest waiting a bit after clicking on it![/p]

notes.title: The Moment Has Arrived! Warborne Above Ashes Global Open Beta Begins!
notes.notes: [p]Welcome to Warborne Above Ashes, Driftmaster![/p][p][/p][p]The global open beta is now live! Join the battle on PC via Steam, Epic, or our official website.[/p][p][/p][p]Servers in Asia, Europe, and the Americas will open in sequence. If you haven’t confirmed your region's launch time yet, you can check the latest announcement here:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3142050/view/505088397281329217?snr=1_5_9_"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Be sure to check out this intel before the servers go live:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Founder's Pack: Limited-time launch week sale![/b][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/3d86d4ffb991dcbc1e6fa772fd9b6b99d274f49b.jpg"][/img][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Season 1 Sector Clash Event: The world's top Warbands face off in fierce battle![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/8d399661ab72826c30ca9151bec790ae59cf4a52.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Whether you're streaming, creating videos, or capturing every heartbeat of the battlefield, these events are not to be missed. Driftmaster, the stage is set—step into the war.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]ːsteamhappyː[url="https://warborne.qoolandgames.com/#/pc/news/detail?articleId=2080"]\[Intelligence Officer Recruitment Program][/url][/p][p]ːsteamhappyː[url="https://warborne.qoolandgames.com/#/pc/news/detail?articleId=2068"]\[Warfront Chronicler Recruitment Program][/url][/p][p][/p][p]And that's just the beginning—come experience Warborne Above Ashes for yourself![/p][p]Also, be sure to check out this Warborne Above Ashes guide! It's packed with tips to help you conquer this galactic battlefield.[/p][p][/p][h2]FAQ[/h2][p][b]Q: What sector (server) do you recommend playing on?[/b][/p][p]A: For the smoothest experience, we recommend selecting the region closest to you. Servers will open in the order Asia → Europe → Americas due to time zone differences, so please be patient if your region isn't live yet. We also suggest that you and your Warband pick a server and faction with fewer players to reduce wait times and improve your gameplay experience.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: How do I know when the servers go live?[/b][/p][p]A: Server launch times are 10:00 AM local time for each region. Please check the time zones below as well as the previous server announcement, and adjust according to your local time:[/p][p][b]Asia (SEC APAC): UTC+8[/b][/p][p][b]Europe (SEC EMEA): UTC+1[/b][/p][p][b]Americas (SEC AMER): UTC-5[/b][/p][p]For the full server launch schedule, please see this announcement:[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3142050/view/505088397281329217?snr=1_5_9_"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Q: What should I do if I see a login/load error with code -5?[/b][/p][p]A: Make sure you're playing under a stable network connection. Using a network booster or third-party accelerator is recommended to resolve this issue.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: How do I claim rewards from the Allies Assemble event and previous playtests?[/b][/p][p]A: Open the \[Events] menu in-game and click \[Past Beta Events & Allies Assemble Rewards]. Follow the on-screen instructions to claim your rewards. Should you have any further questions, check the relevant explanations on this event page.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: How is the number of servers decided?[/b][/p][p]A: Server numbers are based on actual pre-registration numbers and design expectations. We ensure each server has enough players for a full experience. Rest assured: after each season, servers will be connected, allowing players from different planetary servers to interact and battle freely. We are also planning to make cross-sector battles a regular feature, so even if your friends or rivals are on different servers this season, you may face them on the battlefield next season![/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Which platforms is Warborne Above Ashes available on?[/b][/p][p]A: You can play via Steam, Epic Games, or the official PC client. Accounts are cross-platform, and all in-game data is shared, so no matter which platform you choose, you'll fight alongside your allies on the same battlefield.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Will game progress be wiped at launch?[/b][/p][p]A: No. All data will be preserved when the game officially launches. If you can't find your character, please make sure you've selected the sector where your original character resides.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Why are my purchased Solarbite divided into "Available" and "Pending Conversion" portions?[/b][/p][p][b]A:[/b][/p][p]To prevent misuse of the Auction House (such as dispersing funds, transferring improper gains, or bypassing platform monitoring), we've implemented two management categories for Solarbite, Available and Pending Conversion, along with holding periods and risk-control measures:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Available Solarbite[/b]: Can be used in the Auction House, donated to your Warband, spent in the Store, or exchanged for Eclipsium.[/p][p][b]Pending Conversion Solarbite[/b]: Can be spent in the Store or exchanged for Eclipsium, but must be held for 3 days before converting into Available Solarbite.[/p][p][/p][p]Rules in detail:[/p][p]70% of your purchased Solarbite become Available, and 30% Pending Conversion. The Pending Conversion portion becomes Available after a 3-day holding period.[/p][p]As you place more orders and build account credibility, the initial proportion of Available Solarbite will gradually increase, up to 100%.[/p][p]All transactions are fully tracked and monitored. If any violations occur, accounts involved will have all purchased currency revoked (including applying negative balances if necessary) and may face further penalties depending on the severity of the offense, including restricted gameplay or permanent bans.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: How do I switch factions?[/b][/p][p][b]A:[/b][/p][p][b]Limited-Time Availability[/b]: Faction switching is only available during specific periods each season. The exact opening and closing times will be displayed by the \[Switch Faction] button in the \[Faction Info] screen.[/p][p][b]How to Switch[/b]: When faction switching is available, navigate to the \[Faction Info] screen to change factions. Each player may switch only once during each limited-time period.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Why did I suddenly get removed from the map during a battle?[/b][/p][p]A: When a map reaches 200 players, excess combatants are queued out to keep battles smooth. Those with lower \[Combat Power] in the same priority bracket are removed first. For full details, see the latest patch notes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: When does each season end?[/b][/p][p]A:[/p][p]You can track your server's season progress by accessing \[Season] from the menu.[/p][p]When a season ends, players will experience planetary migrations and fresh matchmaking, facing new opponents and embarking on the next wave of campaigns.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: What is War Time?[/b][/p][p]A: War Time is the period during which attacks on Harvester Cores, Strongholds, and enemy Driftmarks are allowed.[/p][p]During this prime time, Warbands carry out strategic planning and tactical coordination. In short, it's a time you want to capitalize on as best you can.[/p][p]War Time varies by server and time zone, so check in-game for the exact schedule.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: How do I unlock more Drifters?[/b][/p][p]A: You can unlock additional Drifters in the Drifter Tavern, which becomes available after unlocking the Underground Bazaar.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Warborne Above Ashes – System Requirements[/b][/p][p][b]A:[/b][/p][p][b]Minimum:[/b][/p][p]OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) / Windows 11 (64-bit)[/p][p]Processor: Intel Core i5-8600 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X[/p][p]Memory: 16 GB RAM[/p][p]Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT[/p][p]DirectX: Version 11[/p][p]Network: Broadband internet connection[/p][p]Storage: 10 GB available space[/p][p]Sound: Onboard[/p][p]VR Support: Not supported[/p][p]Note: Strongly recommended to install on an SSD disk[/p][p][/p][p][b]Recommended:[/b][/p][p]OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) / Windows 11 (64-bit)[/p][p]Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X[/p][p]Memory: 32 GB RAM[/p][p]Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700[/p][p]Network: Broadband internet connection[/p][p]Storage: 10 GB available space[/p][p]Sound: Onboard[/p][p]VR Support: Not supported[/p][p]Note: Installation on an SSD is required[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: How do I report a bug or other issues?[/b][/p][p]A: You can report issues in-game by pressing ESC and clicking the \[Customer Service] button in the lower-right corner (next to the Close button).[/p][p]Alternatively, you can submit feedback via our dedicated support email. [/p][p]Thank you for helping us improve the game![url="https://warborne_support@qoolandgames.com"]warborne_support@qoolandgames.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3142050/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Warborne Above Ashes – Open Beta Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings Driftmasters,[/p][p]
It has been a long journey since the June launch event, and now the Open Beta is upon us — beginning [b]September 19th[/b]! We’re excited to unveil the changes made over the past three months as we refined Season 1 and began laying the foundation for Season 2.[/p][p]While the full details of Season 2 will be revealed later, [b]this update introduces major new content and crucial adjustments to Season 1[/b]. Below is a highlight of the most important changes.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]\[Table of Contents][/b][/h2][olist][*][p]New Features & Content[/p][p]1.1 New Drifter: Vire
1.2 New Weapons & Equipment
1.3 Cross-Server Auction House
1.4 Cross-Server Veinhold Extraction
1.5 New Faction Capital System
1.6 New Open World Vaults
1.7 Central Hub
1.8 Cross-Season Legacy System[/p][/*][*][p]Updates
2.1 New Season Settlement Rules
2.2 Queueing & Map Capacity Adjustments
2.3 Faction Transfer Adjustments
2.4 Harvester Hub Adjustments
2.5 Combat & Balance Adjustments[/p][/*][/olist][h2]New Features & Content[/h2][h3]1.1 New Drifter: Vire[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/0a4ca63dd4b207e39e26c72c51224130743a67dc.png"][/img][/p][p]Active Skill – Bloodstorm[/p][p]Channels for 5s, scattering 8 Blood Seeds (up to 40 total) around the caster every second. Each seed explodes 1.5s after landing, dealing 70% Magic Damage to up to 5 enemies in range. If at least one enemy is hit by the explosion, the caster regenerates 15% Health. Movement speed is boosted by 30% during channeling, decaying over time. Cannot be interrupted.[/p][p][/p][p]Passive Skill – Blood Curse
Dealing damage with skills or attacks marks the target. After 6s, the mark detonates, inflicting 30% True Damage of total damage received during the mark’s duration, and restoring 20% Health to the caster. (Cooldown: 25s)[/p][p][/p][h3]1.2 New Weapons & Equipment[/h3][p]Firearm – Photonic Rifle[/p][p]Skill – Photon Bolt
Scans enemies in front, locking onto 1 enemy every 0.3s, up to 6 (prioritizing unselected enemies). After scanning ends, fires energy projectiles at locked targets, consuming 1 Bullet per target. Each shot deals \[Damage Rate: 175%] Magic Damage, reveals Stealth, and gives Basic Attacks a 40% chance to miss for 6s[/p][p]Bloom Staff – Venomstave[/p][p]Skill – Toxin Injection
Inflicts natural toxins on the target, dealing \[Damage Rate: 80%] Magic Damage every 1 second while reducing Attack Speed by 30% and Movement Speed by 30% for 4 seconds. The toxin's duration is refreshed whenever the target takes damage from the caster's Weapon Skills.[/p][p]Ice Focus – Shard of Fractured Ice[/p][p]Skill – Ice Shards
Removes all Control Effects and generates 6 surrounding Ice Fracture Fragments around the user for 10 seconds. While active, increases Casting Speed by 40% and Damage Resistance by 25%. When other Weapon Skills deal damage, launches 1 Ice Fracture Fragment toward the target, dealing \[Damage Rate: 100%] Magic Damage and applying 10% Reduced Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times.[/p][p]Armor – Riposte-Helm[/p][p]Skill – Hardened Guard
After taking 3 Basic Attack Damages within 5s, gains 65 Block Value (scales with Power) for 6s. This effect enters a 25s cooldown after triggering.[/p][p]Armor – Aegis Robe[/p][p]Skill – Warding
Gains +120 Armor (scales with Power) for 6s. While active, when taking damage from Basic Attacks or Skills, reduces the attacker's damage output by 40% and Movement Speed by 30% for 4s.[/p][p]Armor – Whirlwind Boots[/p][p]Skill – Cyclone
Increases Attack Speed by 30%, Spellcasting Speed by 30%, and Movement Speed by 30% for nearby allied targets, lasting 5s.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]1.3 Cross-Server Auction House[/h3][p]Seasonal legacy items (Blueprints, Cosmetics, MODs) can now be traded globally across servers.[/p][p]Non-global items (e.g., Consumables, Eclipsium-related items) remain server-bound.[/p][p]Buying items from other servers incurs additional shipping fees. Fees are a percentage of the item price:[/p][list][*][p][b]Planetary Shipping Fee:[/b] Same sector, different server[/p][/*][*][p][b]Galactic Shipping Fee:[/b] Different sector[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]1.4 Veinhold Extraction (Cross-Server)[/h3][p]Players can now queue for Veinhold Extraction across servers within the same sector.[/p][p]Cross-sector matchmaking is not supported.[/p][p]This adds more competitive features and opportunities to spar with other players in the same sector.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]1.5 Faction Capital[/h3][p]Each Faction map now has a neutral Capital Harvester Hub.[/p][p]The first Warband of a Faction to capture it establishes control of the Capital.[/p][p]That Warband’s leader is promoted to Faction Warlord, gaining access to National Policies, powerful buffs that apply across their territory.[/p][p]After establishing the capital, nearby map areas will be incorporated into the capital’s territory, granting enhanced resource yields.[/p][p]Top 3 Warbands in a Faction can declare war on the reigning Capital holder to seize sovereignty.[/p][p]Enemy Factions can invade a Capital Harvester Hub through territorial connections. Occupying an enemy Capital Harvester Hub only disables their Capital functions; you cannot build your own Capital on enemy territory.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]1.6 Open World Vaults[/h3][p]New underground vaults can now spawn dynamically in contested zones.[/p][p]Objective: Defeat all enemies and claim the treasures within.[/p][p]Vaults upgrade over time, increasing difficulty, rewards, and player capacity (5–7, across 2 Factions).[/p][p]Maps are nonlinear, with branching paths and ambush opportunities.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]1.7 Central Server[/h3][p]At the end of the season, before the new Season begins, players can travel via their local Underground Bazaar to a Central Server, a cross-server social space.[/p][p]Features:[/p][p]Duels & Combat Dummies[/p][p]Chat & Social Gathering[/p][p]Cross-server Party Matching for next Season[/p][hr][/hr][h3]1.8 Seasonal Legacy System[/h3][p]Fully Preserved:[/p][list][*][p][b]Driftmaster & Cosmetics:[/b] Driftmaster Titles, Avatars (including frames), acquired mounts, Driftmark appearances, emotes, sprays, and other cosmetic items.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Key Progression:[/b] Unlocked Drifters (including Mastery Levels), unlocked equipment training (including Battle Infusion and Hypercharge Levels), acquired Mods, unlocked Boost Station recipes.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Currency:[/b] Eternal currencies such as Solarbite, Eclipsium, Season Merit, Data Fragments, Veinhold Medals, Spray Tokens, etc.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Items:[/b] Appearance unlock items (including fragments), Equipment Training Blueprints, MODle cores, Drifter and Equipment Battle Scars.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Other:[/b] Subscription status, friends list.[/p][/*][/list][p]Partially Preserved:[/p][list][*][p][b]Progression:[/b] Drifter and Equipment Mastery levels will be reset, with a portion of the pre-reset levels converted into Universal XP. Acquired Universal XP will also carry over to the next season at a certain percentage.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Legion Rank:[/b] Legion Ranks will be partially carried over at a set scale.[/p][/*][/list][p]Reset Each Season:[/p][list][*][p][b]Progression:[/b] Driftmaster levels, Driftmark Tech, Drifter Tiers (including attribute points).[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Currency:[/b] Seasonal currencies such as Starfall Tokens, Repair Vouchers, Exergy Ores, Faction Medals, PvP Medals, and Warband Medals.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Items:[/b] Weapons, armor, and other equipment, as well as consumables like healing potions and Starfall Token Crates.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Warband:[/b] Warband ranks, Warband Driftmarks, Warband Driftmark Techn, Warband Funds and vehicles etc. Any remaining Solarbite will be evenly distributed to all Warband members during settlement.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Events:[/b] Survival Guide, Faction missions and passes, Season progression, Daily sign-ins and Power Upgrades events, etc.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]System Updates[/h2][h3]2.1 New Season Settlement Rules[/h3][p]To add more strategy and competition at season end, the settlement system has been reworked.

notes.title: Dev Log: New Season Settlement System
notes.notes: [h2]It's Been a While, Driftmasters![/h2][h3]The Time Has Come![/h3][p]The first campaign of [i]Warborne[/i] is gearing up for launch. As some of the earliest supporters of our game, we believe it's essential to give you an early heads-up with more advanced intel—[/p][p]We remember that many Driftmasters in the community have shared plenty of feedback and suggestions about our final victory settlement. Now, we can finally respond: The brand-new season settlement will debut in the very first season after [i]Warborne[/i]'s launch, making it more fun, more exciting, and—possibly—with far more than just one winner.[/p][p]Our game isn't just about skillful operations; it's a strategic showdown. You and your Warband or organization, no matter the size, are all key players on this battlefield sandbox.[/p][p]We don't like beating around the bush, so let's dive right in:[/p][p][/p][h3]New Performance Settlement Mechanism: Richer Strategy![/h3][p]Yes, after our discussions, we've decided to adjust [i]Warborne[/i]'s season victory mechanism—this means we're removing the mechanic where simply occupying the \[Forgeheart] grants direct victory![/p][p][b]Now, the ultimate victory rule is: At the end of the season, the total occupation value of captured Hubs and Fortresses will determine the ranking and rewards for all the mighty contenders![/b][/p][p]Of course, the levels of the Hubs you occupy still determine your final score, and the \[Forgeheart] remains a crucial factor on this planetary battlefield. That said, you can secure your place on the planet in various ways, especially since: [b]This planet's victors might even be more than one[/b].[/p][p]Next, I'd like to introduce our Warband tier settlement mechanism: In the first season of [i]Warborne[/i]'s official launch, your war performance will be rated across several tiers for distributing spoils. Here are the four Warband tiers:[/p][list][*][p][b]Sovereign[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Warlord[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Reclaimer[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Survivor[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The specific values are still in design, and we'll provide the exact breakdowns soon. But the goal is crystal clear: The planetary battlefield won't be a zero-sum game. You can do more than just fight—there's room for alliances and cunning strategies.[/p][p][/p][p]As your Warband achieves different tiers through battles, you'll reap the fruits of victory together at the end of the month's campaign: [b]From rare Avatar Frames and Eclipsium, to Season Merits that can be exchanged for unique content[/b]. Plus, the Mod Cores that are vital for your long-term personal combat power. [i]Warborne[/i] must ensure that every day you fight tooth and nail in the season won't be in vain.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/9328aeda04cdfa3a5420cf7900e01bc00e7e99c6.png"][/img][img src="https://alidocs.dingtalk.com/core/api/resources/img/5eecdaf48460cde50dbf9b218f9d2db746962fbc9682705175b8339e1c4c24831b75b38faadcd24bec177c308ebd53047937c83b28ede30b55a5e05ccfa3c69300f01bf568e9de3ad20e879d168127039152cc42b4cde1644fb4c8ed7016461c?tmpCode=791f0e98-0f34-4954-ab51-f17c23422d93"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/0a3d952b0cbcbe0467d5712fc9cc3b83cc5a066a.png"][/img][/p][p]Yes, this applies to every Warband. [i]Warborne[/i]'s war ecosystem will be vibrant and diverse. Small and medium-sized Warbands are just as important to us. In our first season, you'll find that in many scenarios, these smaller Warbands can become the pivotal players that tip the scales.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Occupation Mechanism: Everyone's a War Strategist[/h3][p]In fact, through several tests, we've clearly seen the plight of small and medium-sized teams on the planetary battlefield: Once large Warbands kick their war machines into gear, smaller ones are left with only two choices—either become affiliates of the big ones or occupy low-value blocks on the battlefield's edges. Honestly, that's not the experience we want to provide.[/p][p]So, before [i]Warborne[/i]'s official launch, we've made a key adjustment to the occupation mechanism: All Warbands now have an occupation limit of 10 Hubs/Fortresses. You can capture higher-value advanced Hubs/Fortresses to achieve greater final occupation values.[/p][p]We hope this change makes choosing which Hubs to occupy a core part of every Warband's strategic gameplay—even the most powerful Warbands can't simply dominate the entire world through sheer strength alone. You'll need scientific deployments to achieve your goals and prevent strong rivals from snatching your victories![/p][p]For small and medium-sized Warbands, this is absolutely the best opportunity. You'll naturally hold the most important bargaining chips. Your battles could create completely unpredictable reactions on this sandbox battlefield, even shifting the overall landscape through your decisions.[/p][p]No matter which Warband you belong to, the choices will be in your hands. This will be a completely unpredictable strategic gameplay experience—[/p][p][b]But there's one thing that's inevitable in [i]Warborne[/i]:[/b][/p][p][b]Every Warband has the potential to become the protagonist of this world.[/b][/p][h3]And There's More![/h3][p]We hope you're satisfied with this optimization to [i]Warborne[/i]'s overall season rules—if not, feel free to share your thoughts in the comments or on Discord anytime. This isn't the final version; we'll continue listening to your feedback![/p][p]We'll be releasing more and more content about [i]Warborne[/i]'s first season soon. Stay tuned to our Steam and Discord communities—I promise you won't be disappointed![/p][p][b]See you soon![/b][/p]

notes.title: What We've Been Working On
notes.notes: [p]Hey Driftmasters,[/p][p]It's been a while![/p][p]More than a month has passed since our last war, and I believe everyone reading this has one burning question:[/p][p][/p][p][b]When will Warborne launch?[/b][/p][p]We have to say, we've been keeping a close eye on the community's concerns about our progress, and we've even seen some... "interesting" rumors floating around. But we feel it's time to give you a clear answer:[/p][h3][b]Warborne will launch as scheduled in 2025, kicking off a global war! The official launch date will be announced in August![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]To meet this goal, we're working at full throttle to put the final pieces of the puzzle together. Now, let's talk about what we've accomplished recently.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What have we been busy with?[/b][/h3][p]As a long-term, live-service game, we have no intention of presenting Warborne to you in a "half-baked" state. Therefore, our recent efforts have been focused on ensuring a high-quality and substantial content pipeline. Specifically, here are a few areas we're working on:[/p][p][b]Further Polishing Season 1:[/b] The first month of war is incredibly important to us. Based on our reviews and summaries of previous tests, we're making the following improvements:[/p][list][*][p][b]\[Adjustments to the Season-End System]:[/b] A brand-new system is on its way. We want to ensure that no matter the size of your Guild, you can be a pivotal force on the battlefield and show off your victories.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Combat & Faction Balance]:[/b] This one needs no introduction. We are continuously making detailed tweaks to make Warborne fairer and more fun.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Queueing Rule Optimization]:[/b] Based on feedback and data from the last few playtests, we're further refining the queueing rules. Our goal is crystal clear: to get the strongest Driftmasters into the battle faster.[/p][/*][/list][p]All the above is still in progress, and more details will be shared later. If you have any questions, please let us know in the community![/p][p][/p][p][b]Ensuring Content Quality and Pipeline for Launch.[/b] This is even more critical: making sure that after the initial one-month experience, you can [b]seamlessly dive[/b] into an even more epic battlefield. This brings us to a rough outline of Season 2:[/p][p][/p][p][b]About Season 2:[/b] We want every day in Warborne to be filled with novelty and challenges. That's why we've recently dedicated most of our energy to developing content for the S2 pipeline. notes.title: Dev Letter: Warborne Above Ashes Server Structure Overview
notes.notes:
[h2]Long time no see, Driftmasters:[/h2]

We hope this brief armistice hasn't dulled your fighting spirit. Today we'd like to introduce something many of you have been curious about: the Server and Season mechanics for Warborne.

This is the most important gameplay blueprint for the future of Warborne Above Ashes—and one of the core pillars of the Warborne Universe. Be patient, Driftmasters. You're going to like this.

[h2]Born for War: The Universe, Galaxies, and Planets of Warborne Above Ashes[/h2]

Before we delve into the specifics of servers, we want to explain the core philosophy and vision behind the server architecture of Warborne Above Ashes:

Uniting players from around the world in a single universe for all-out warfare and thrilling combat—this is the ultimate goal of Warborne Above Ashes. The game is designed as a sci-fi post-apocalyptic MMORPG with a focus on large-scale PvP combat.
However, real-world physical constraints—such as single-server capacity, time zone differences, and network latency—often impact the player experience. To address this, we've adopted a "Galaxy - Planet - Stargate" architecture to maximize cross-regional interaction and ensure fair competition.

[b]● Unified Existence: [/b]All Driftmasters exist within the same interconnected universe.
[b]● Geographical Recommendation:[/b] Players will be recommended galaxies based on time zones and network conditions for the most optimal experience:

[h3]Sec Sunder (UTC-1 to UTC-5): Europe, Africa
Sec Darktide (UTC-10 to UTC-4): North America, South America
Sec Astracinder (UTC-5 to UTC-10): Asia, Oceania[/h3]

At the start of each season, multiple “Planets” (i.e. servers in the traditional sense) will be dynamically created in each Galaxy based on activity levels.  Each Planet will host a month-long Conquest Season, where players compete for multiple honors such as Planetary Sovereign, Warlord, Reclaimer, and Survivor. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/9e7eb56cc18b03eb5afe1f9bc3e2bd37a33c7915.jpg[/img]

[h2]Season Reset Mechanics[/h2]

[b]Every day in Warborne will be forged in blood and fire[/b]—we want every season to feel fresh and fiercely competitive for all Driftmasters. This applies both within a single season and between seasons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/291f4e335e13c245a61ddfe94d408dfe7035e546.png[/img]

To maintain the intensity and novelty of combat, upon a season reset, we will:

[b]● RESET: Progression and technology affecting Power (e.g. Drifter levels, Driftmark technology, etc). [/b]These will not carry over to the next season.

[b]● RETAIN: [/b]All unlocked Drifters, Equipment, Battle Scars, Cosmetics, etc., that you have acquired can be brought into the next season.

[b]● PARTIALLY RETAIN:[/b] Based on your performance in the previous season, a portion of your Mastery and Legion Rank will be appropriately retained.

Please refer to the comprehensive list for the specific items for season reset and retention (this is not the final version and may be subject to change in the official game):

Please refer to the comprehensive list for the specific items for season reset and retention (this is not the final version and may be subject to change in the official game):

[i]Retained over Seasons:
● Driftmaster and Cosmetic Content: Driftmaster titles, Avatars (including Avatar frames), acquired mounts, Driftmarks, emotes, sprays, and other cosmetics.
● Important Progression Content: Unlocked Drifters (including Battle Infusion levels), unlocked equipment (including Hypercharge and Battle Infusion levels), acquired Mods, unlocked Boost Station recipes.
● Currencies: Solarbite, Eclipsium, Data Fragments, Spray Tokens, Season Merits.
● Items: Cosmetic unlock items (including fragments), equipment training blueprints, Mod Cores, Drifter and Equipment Battle Scars.
● Other: Subscription status, Friend list.

Partially retained across Seasons:
● Progression Content: Drifter and Equipment Mastery levels will be reset. A certain percentage, based on the pre-reset levels, will be converted into Universal XP. Acquired Universal XP will also be partially carried over to the next season.
● Legion Rank: Legion Ranks will be scaled and carry over.

Reset across Seasons:
● Progression Content: Driftmaster Level, Driftmark technology, Drifter Tier-levels (including point allocation).
● Currencies: Starfall Tokens, Exergy, Repair Vouchers, Faction Medals, PvP Medals, Warband Medals, Void Exergy, Loot Bonus Tokens, etc.
● Items: Weapons, armor, and various other equipment items, Recovery flasks, Starfall Token Chests and other consumables.
● Warbands: Warbands, Warband Driftmarks, Warband technology, Warband funds, Warband vehicles, etc will be disbanded and removed. Leftover Solarbite in the Warband will be automatically distributed equally among all Warband members on reset.
● Activities and Systems: Survival Guide, Faction Missions and Faction Pass, Season Progression, Daily Check-in, Power Upgrade events, and other activities.[/i]

[h2]Central Server of Each Galaxy – The Gate[/h2]

[h3]What is the Gate?[/h3]

The Gate is the central server that exists between season transitions:
[b]● Activation Timing: [/b]The Gate will open after Season Settlement concludes on your current Planet till before a new season begins.

[b]● Social Hub: [/b]Players can reach The Gate via teleportation devices, allowing them to freely engage in combat practice and interact with players from across the entire galaxy.

[b]● Eternal Glory: [/b]The glorious deeds of Season Victors will be permanently inscribed within the Gate for posterity to admire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/e767710537893f2c9950aaa2ca29f835e0428c74.png[/img]

[h3]Regroup and seek out new opponents on new Planets[/h3]

[b]● Team Reformation: [/b]After a season ends, return to the Gate with your spoils, where you can meet old comrades and new Driftmasters.

[b]● Forge Alliances and Face Challenges:[/b] Driftmasters can freely form teams, make new allies, and venture forth to conquer new Planets.

[b]● Diverse Adversaries: [/b]Constantly changing teams and environments ensure that every expedition is filled with fresh challenges.

[b]This is the transit station for the entire galaxy during planetary wars: here you can find Driftmasters from other Planets, communicate and spar with them and prepare for the upcoming wars on the next Planet!
[/b]

[h2]Cross-Server Gameplay Within the Galaxy[/h2]

We will consider the following methods to enhance interaction among Driftmasters from different Planets within the same galaxy:

[b]● Cross-Server Matchmaking:[/b] Cross-Server matchmaking for "Veinhold Extraction" and possibly a "Galactic Arena". This will support cross-server confrontations within the galaxy, enriching gameplay and reducing unfair cooperation and cheating.

In the future, we will also strive to ensure that Driftmasters from different Planets will be able to have engaging interactions and communication (limitations permitting)!

[h2]Legacy of the Nomad Empire: Interstellar Trading and Migration[/h2]

As descendants of the once-lost Nomad Empire, all in the Warborne universe still retain this unique nomadic instinct—a yearn for trade and migration that cannot be diminished.

In the future, Warborne Above Ashes will introduce two brand-new systems, and I am thrilled to announce them to you in advance: "Interstellar Trading" and "Interstellar Migration".

[h3]Interstellar Trading[/h3]
In the war-torn universe of Warborne Above Ashes, crucial war materials are mainly obtained from the Planets themselves. However, wares from distant galaxies, some scarce and valuable goods can be found occasionally from certain special markets.

In the future Interstellar Trading market of Warborne Above Ashes, you will be able to trade certain non-core consumables with players from different regions of other galaxies: this will include[b] cosmetics, mounts, blueprints, recipes, etc[/b].

This means that even if you are not in a highly populated or active galaxy or Planet, you can still access goods from other players across the entire Warborne universe.

[i]*To ensure the stability of the season's ecosystem, consumables and equipment will still be restricted to trading within the current Planet.[/i]

[h3]Interstellar Migration[/h3]

Migrating to better Planets for conquest is one of the fundamental desires of all Driftmasters and Warbands. We will be opening Interstellar Migration in a future version:

● After each season settlement, players may have the opportunity to migrate to other galaxies through the Interstellar Migration system to challenge opponents from different regions.

● We will continuously optimize the cross-time zones and cross-regional network experience, striving to make every expedition smooth and seamless.Allowing all Driftmasters to freely execute strategic objectives in the Warborne universe is one of our primary goals! We believe Interstellar Migration will provide everyone with richer experiences and stories!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/d037f23cecf8ca18e9533b70b88237203665deb4.png[/img]

[h3]Conclusion[/h3]
How does this sound? We hope this summary of the season and server structure gives you a deeper understanding of what Warborne Above Ashes will look like in the future. But, of course, this is just a small part—the war for Planetary Conquest, I imagine, would be what you are most focused on.

We will soon discuss a series of upcoming changes, including combat modifications. If that interests you, please feel free to [url=steam://store/3142050]add Warborne Above Ashes to your wishlist[/url]—Trust us, we won't let you down.We will see you soon again, Driftmaster.

notes.title: April War Games Festival Test Thank-You Letter
notes.notes:
[b]Body:[/b]

A proud salute to your valor displayed, Driftmasters!
The past 30 days have flown by, and together, we've witnessed Warborne's first large-scale campaign! It was[b] EPIC![/b]

This War Games Festival test was our first-ever test featuring all 6 factions on the full map. It was a 'first' for us—meaning it came with immense tests and challenges. We did encounter a few hiccups along the way, but thanks to the brilliant tactics and unwavering support received from every Driftmaster, we've successfully concluded this test phase! This was all thanks to you, Driftmasters!

[h1]1. Final War Report[/h1]

Now, it's time to tally the final results from this Warborne test. While you may have experienced victories and defeats on the battlefield, what follows is a milestone written in your collective blood and sweat—there are no losers here, Driftmasters.

In this test, we were honored to bring together[b] 126,188[/b] players from[b] 128 [/b]countries and regions across the globe!
Furthermore, a total of [b]326 Warbands[/b] took part in this battle! Your iron-willed Warbands carved breathtaking sagas of slaughter, blood, and conquest across the lands of every planet!

Our strategic goal for this phase—as you all know—was our Steam Wishlist. We've hit [b]100,000 [/b]wishlists and are about to break into the[b] TOP 400[/b] on Steam's rankings! This glory belongs to all our Driftmasters! Of course, we want to keep this momentum going, so we're calling on all of you to lend us a hand (and a click) to add one more to that wishlist count!

We also want to share a milestone victory with you: We've hit [b][u]NUMBER ONE[/u] on Steam's upcoming releases chart![/b] We are incredibly grateful for your support, which is our biggest motivation to bring you an even better game.

Finally, during the test, we closely monitored various player activities in Warborne. After analyzing player data, we're thrilled to see that [b]you enjoyed Warborne even more this time around. This gives us confidence we're on the right track. [/b]For the dev team, nothing is more encouraging than this!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/307d2c958da12cfd677d28d8bef307da57c92e23.jpg[/img]

[h1]2. Thank You Driftmasters![/h1]

Thank you, Driftmasters, from all corners of the world! You've ignited the flames of war in Warborne, fires that will burn across entire planets—flames destined to never be extinguished!
Please see below for the list of names!

[b](Placeholder for Thank-You Letter Image)[/b]

Yes, we felt that mere words weren't enough. So, to express our gratitude for your continuous support, we've prepared a more memorable gift: a thank-you letter to commemorate the help Warborne received in reaching this precious milestone.
We kindly request every Warband leader and individual on the list to fill in your shipping information via the link below! This is very important to us; we would like to express our deepest appreciation to the help and support received throughout the test.

[url=https://wj.qoolandgames.com/p/aY4aHBWG]https://wj.qoolandgames.com/p/aY4aHBWG[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/19205956d059e8489971cfde01bd26030d084e37.jpg[/img]

[h1]3. Issues and Concerns[/h1]

The war is never over. After reviewing the achievements of the full-scale war test, it's time to discuss the problems that still exist. We've heard your voices, and all your issues and suggestions have been recorded. Now, let's talk about the most frequently raised concerns by Commanders:

[h2]3.1 Server/Faction Activity and Competitiveness[/h2]

Regarding the decline in activity and player attrition in certain factions and servers during the test, we briefly mentioned this in previous announcements. Here, we'll explain in more detail:
We are planning to introduce more diverse frontlines and objectives—capturing 'The Heartforge' will no longer be the sole criterion for victory.

We will also limit the number of Harvester Hubs a Warband can occupy. Although factions with more players might capture more Harvester Hubs, Warbands with high-quality elite teams can still achieve victory by controlling key, high-value Harvester Hubs! You will have more opportunities and strategies to realize your ambitions and dominance on this planet!

Furthermore, we firmly believe that a relative balance of power between factions makes the global conflict more challenging and engaging. New faction-switching rules and a series of changes aimed at faction balance are already in the works. The goal is singular: to give underdog factions more room to maneuver. A temporary setback or weakness absolutely does not mean defeat for the season. The war isn't over until the very last moment!

[h2]3.2 Queueing Rules[/h2]

I know many Driftmasters have been wondering: the queueing rules have been adjusted several times, so what's the current conclusion?
We have to admit, changes to queueing rules for a single scenario can lead to a multitude of knock-on effects. We need to consider an extremely large number of possibilities, which is why adjusting queueing rules is so tricky.
However, no more excuses, here are the adjustments we've made based on your feedback and our team's discussions:

[i]● When a map reaches its player cap (200), a queue will be triggered to ensure combat experience. Players with [Lower Power] at the same priority level will be removed from the map.

[b] ● Balancing Participating Parties:[/b]
    ○ Queues will be balanced according to the participating parties (each faction is an independent participating party; Warbands that have declared war are also considered independent participating parties). 
    ○  The number of players from different participating parties allowed onto the map will be calculated based on the number of party members (in the map + in queue) who meet the Power requirements (Power requirements will gradually increase as the season progresses).
       ■ For example: If the Ashen Faction has a total of 200 players (in the map + in queue) and the Sirius Faction has a total of 100 players (in the map + in queue), then the ratio of players from Ashen and Sirius allowed into the map will be 2:1.
    ○  A mininum number of slots per Participating Party will be protected to ensure their experience (the more participating parties there are, the fewer the number of protected slots per Participating Party).

[b]● Priority Settings:[/b]
    ○ For Warbands level 10 and above, Warband Leaders, Vice Leaders, and Warband Commanders will have higher priority within their Warband.
    ○ During War Time, defending Warbands occupying the Harvester Hub on the current map and Warbands that are eligible to capture this Harvester Hub (those that have occupied neighboring Harvester Hubs) will have higher priority than other Warbands of the same faction. 

[b]● Other:[/b]
    ○ After map queuing is triggered, players on the map that do not participate in PvP activities for an extended period and have low activity will be removed from the map.[/i]

Ensuring the map queuing rules deliver the intended intense but balanced experience is our end goal. This will require further testing and long-term tuning. We will continue to strive tirelessly for improvement and appreciate your patience on this matter.

[h2]3.3 Combat Balance - Always a Work in Progress![/h2]

We've made further combat balance adjustments based on actual combat performance and feedback!
Our main goal and direction remain unchanged: to increase the diversity of various builds, allowing all kinds of equipment and Drifters to have their place on the battlefield! We also aim to provide everyone with a more stable and enjoyable combat experience! Please wait for our subsequent announcements for detailed changes!

[h2]3.4 Seasons[/h2]

Yes, the concept of 'Seasons.' We feel that this wasn't conveyed intuitively enough to players during this full-scale war test.
From planets to star systems, from seasons to the settlements—what do these all mean in Warborne? We will be providing detailed answers very soon.
Of course, I believe everyone is most concerned about the tangible aspects: What content and progression can I carry over to the next season to get a head start?
We are happy to announce that we already have a finalized plan, and it will be announced soon along with our season plan. Please stay tuned, we are sure it won't disappoint!

[h1]4. Next Test and Open Beta Plans[/h1]

Finally, yes, war. Let's return to war: Over these 30 days, some Driftmasters may not have had their fill of the thrill of battle, while others may be simmering with the anger and disappointment of temporary defeat. Rest assured, the time to unleash it all will soon come again—[b]we will be conducting our next test in June. The test schedule is as follows:[/b]

[b]June 7th - June 17th[/b] [i](Detailed times and server plans will be presented in a future announcement)[/i]

Yes, it's a somewhat unexpected test, and I believe many Driftmasters will have questions. Next, I'll select some of the issues we feel must be clarified and provide the relevant answers:

[h2]4.1 Why start a new test so soon after the Total War test?[/h2]

As a new game launching this year, the Steam Next Fest in June is a unique opportunity for us to expose Warborne to PvP players worldwide. This unmissable event is both a challenge and an opportunity for us. We are working hard on adjustments and hope to attract even more players, to experience the fun of PvP in our game at the Next Fest! 

[b]This should also be our last large-scale public test before the Open Beta![/b]

[h2]4.2 So, what's the difference between this test and the previous one?[/h2]

We'll be honest, since the Total War test and this upcoming test are quite close in timing, this one will focus more on further optimizations and adjustments based on issues from the previous version. [b]There won't be significant differences between the two versions.[/b]

Of course, if you still haven't had enough from the last test and want to dive back into battle, you are more than welcome! In fact, we've prepared a series of new goodies for our veteran Driftmasters—[b]exclusive mounts, avatar frames, avatars, and custom Warband emblems[/b]—all await your return to the battlefield!

New Driftmasters! After seeing this call to arms, we sincerely hope that fresh blood like you will join this battlefield! This will be a very interesting feast of war. Regardless of your prior battlefield experience, as long as you bring a few comrades-in-arms, I believe you will definitely have a great PvP war experience!

[h2]4.3 So, when exactly is the Open Beta?[/h2]

Yes, speaking of Open Beta! We are very happy to announce that [b]Warborne will launch its Open Beta in the second half of 2025.[/b] Please give us a little more time to improve the game and have faith in us. We will do everything possible to perfect Warborne more quickly, so everyone can experience truly excellent warfare.

In the Open Beta version, we will have more new content and better adjustments awaiting Driftmasters. We want to ensure that when the true war horn sounds,[i][b] everyone[/b][/i] can experience the ultimate PvP combat fun! We're waiting for you and your comrades to join the endless battle!

[h2]4.4 So, do you have further follow-up plans?[/h2]

Rest assured, the Open Beta is definitely not the end. Afterwards, we will gradually reveal more brand-new things to Driftmasters in the community—from better changes to updated content!

Furthermore, we are also considering more open and diverse ways to co-create Warborne with our community. Please keep an eye on our future announcements and event information!

notes.title: Warborne Above Ashes Developer Memo: What We’ve Been Solving in These 40 Days
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, Driftmaster:[/b]

By now, you’ve likely caught wind of some thrilling updates about our upcoming test for the War Game Festival in these two articles:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3142050/view/512955743573377461]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3142050/view/512955743573377461[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3142050/view/512955743573377758]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3142050/view/512955743573377758[/url]

With the test just around the corner, we, the development team, want to seize this moment to dig into some deeper, design-driven details: what changes have we made over the past 40 days? Warborne Above Ashes is far from flawless—our initial test with players exposed plenty of issues, many of which we’re still tackling. So, beyond the shiny new features and content, if you’re curious about the game, we’d love to share a more granular look at our thought process as developers.

If you joined us for the last test, you’d probably agree on one thing: the previous version of Warborne Above Ashes felt incomplete. This time, our mission is crystal clear: to deliver a true Warborne Above Ashes experience—a full, immersive season. This will be a comprehensive stress test for the entire game, but it’s also your golden opportunity to dive into the total war on the chaos planet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/10f4cedd4e2063d1b91668f200ee5164f3d9c552.png[/img]

Drawing from the feedback you gave us in March, we’ve wrestled with several core challenges over these 40 days:
● Delivering a more complete game experience
● Preparing for more Driftmasters
● Improving game balance
● Enhancing the experience for Driftmasters at every stage

You’ll notice that every tweak in this War Game Festival test orbits around these issues. In the sections below, we’ll walk you through our approach to solving them. We’re still polishing things up, but if this memo helps you feel the dev team’s vision in the revamped Warborne Above Ashes, then we’ve hit the mark.

[h2]Building a Complete Warborne Above Ashes[/h2]

From fully implementing six factions to fine-tuning various gameplay elements, we’ve covered a lot in past articles. But what we haven’t unpacked is this: [b]why these specific changes?[/b]

For an MMO, every test has a distinct purpose. If the March test was about letting you taste the adrenaline of ZvZ warfare on the chaos planet, this War Game Festival test is the real deal—a full-blown, month-long, multi-faction war season.

This demands more content to fuel a prolonged conflict. Spatially, whether it’s the six factions you can pick from or the expanded planetary map, everything is crafted to plunge you into the chaos of war.

We’ve also rolled out a new teleportation mechanic: [b]Echo-Rift.[/b] These strange phenomena, scattered across the planet, let you teleport to specific spots—sometimes once, sometimes multiple times—and pop up randomly on the map. Whether you’re catching a quick ride or plotting a “visit” to another faction’s turf, they inject a fresh spatial twist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/1d519830387ee315371ae27ace24efc53978dcf9.png[/img]

More critically, the planet’s heart—the Scorchforged City, which you couldn’t touch last time—is now up for grabs. With enough time and war resources, you can finally claim this ultimate prize.

Time-wise, a 30-day season calls for diverse gameplay to keep resource gathering efficient and engaging. That’s why we’ve layered in varied content like Warband ranking rewards in Veinhold Extraction and new, high-risk Veinholds. These PvPvE additions not only flesh out Warborne Above Ashes but also let us tweak gameplay balance for a more electrifying ride.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/5a5964068fa4ffcb28a010e9feaa380d5f838a95.png[/img]

Content, though, is just the bedrock. We know that welcoming more Driftmasters while keeping the experience smooth is a real-world challenge. For any MMO, it’s a tough puzzle—next, we’ll break down how we’re piecing it together.

[h2]Balance and Trade-offs: New Server Population Mechanics[/h2]

If you were with us in March, you’ll recall the queuing headaches that plagued everyone. No one wants to twiddle their thumbs while the battle rages—and it was a major sore spot.

Worse still, the War Game Festival is set to draw an even bigger crowd. To dodge a repeat disaster, we’ve made overhauling our server queue logic our top priority. In short, we’ve reshaped it around a few key sub-goals:

[b]● Prioritizing the War’s Protagonists[/b]
In a limited battlefield, deciding “who gets in first” is tricky, but we can probably agree on this: the two main warring factions are the stars of the show. So, we’ve introduced a “strategic priority” system. During war times, the two factions with the greatest strategic stake in a battlefield get first dibs. They’re the protagonists—but we’ve also carved out room for third-party “disruptors.” After all, who doesn’t love a wild card?Even more vital: Warbands outrank factions. Those holding or bordering the battlefield get top-tier access. They’re the stars among stars. Gear up to defend your frontline turf!

[b]● Ensuring Fairer Matchups[/b]
We’ve also tackled non-war skirmishes—those sudden clashes that can snowball fast and often turn lopsided. When these encounters hit a certain scale, war-time rules kick in, adjusting the power balance via priority access.

[b]● Might Makes Right[/b]
Forget Legion Ranks—now, your Power calls the shots for battlefield entry. Stronger players get in quicker, facing tougher foes but reaping bigger contribution rewards. High risk, high reward—it’s our take on fairness.
[b]
● Battlefield Kick Mechanics[/b]
Yes, they’re still here (and yes, we’re still working on clearer communication about them—sorry!). We prioritize booting offline or idle players, but in dire straits, we’ll ensure the main factions, Warbands, and top warriors get their chance to shine.

As for those infamous server queues, we’re expecting a solid upgrade—but we’ll be keeping a close eye on your experience during the test, ready to make urgent tweaks if needed.

[h2]A Healthier Game Ecosystem[/h2]

Beyond queues, more Driftmasters mean fewer resources per player. To fix this, we’ve rolled out a dynamic respawn system: resource refresh times now scale with player density in your area, so you can take down your Fire-Eater faster.

But a bigger player base also shakes up the game’s ecosystem. Thankfully, with your March feedback in hand, we’ve built systems to keep Warborne Above Ashes thriving.

[b]● Catch-Up Mechanics[/b]
As we’ve hyped, Warborne Above Ashes is a 24/7 battlefield you can jump into anytime. But in a month-long season, how do latecomers keep up? Meet the LaterShop: this enigmatic vendor peddles items like level tickets and Exergy to fast-track your early growth. Depending on when your Warband joins, you’ll earn catch-up points. As promised, you can dive into the fight anytime without lagging behind—just join the war!

[b]● Fairer Rewards[/b]
In March, Harvester Hub rewards left us wanting—we don’t want your hard-won victories snatched away. For this test, the Warband with the highest contribution claims the hub. And rewards? They’re getting more inclusive: most Warband-related goodies, not just from hubs, will land straight in your mailbox. You can even send your top warriors to Veinhold Extraction, boosting your whole Warband with leaderboard rewards.

[b]● Numerical Balance[/b]
To keep this memo from dragging, we’ll save the gritty number-crunching for later patch notes. But rest assured, we’ve overhauled everything—base stats, Drifters, skills, war tools. Balance is a marathon, not a sprint, and we’re eager for your feedback.

Lastly, let’s talk something near and dear to all of us: fairness in Warborne Above Ashes. We want small Warbands and solo players to revel in the chaos too. To that end, we’ve poured just as much effort into optimizing individual experiences as anything else—trust us on that.

[h2]A Friendlier Chaos Planet[/h2]
Contradictory? Maybe. But as a 2025 MMO, we’ll admit Warborne Above Ashes has room to grow for less mainstream Driftmasters. Beyond epic wars, there’s still plenty of fun to be had.

[b]● Warbands and Logistics[/b]
If you and a few pals just want to kick back in Warborne Above Ashes, we’ve eased the growth curve—step up as vital rear-guard merchants. In a drawn-out war, managing resources and logistics can outweigh capturing a stronghold. We want you in on this, so we’ve added trading and logistics systems. Our aim? To spark stable, win-win alliances between frontline Warbands and smaller support crews.But trade convoys won’t glide by unscathed. We insist players escort their goods, turning “supply lines” into a strategic layer—every trade and transport is ripe for disruption.

[b]● Warbands and Logistics (Continued)[/b]
Once your crew scales up, our Warband quest system takes over, dishing out tasks like expanding your Warband or testing new combat styles. Through these rewards, we want your group to evolve into a powerhouse “Warband” on the planet.We’ll be watching this new system closely and tweaking it as needed to nail our goals.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/574e345ad4c4e89be95a11a774690f82a4dfd094.png[/img]

[b]● Everyone’s Experience[/b]
We’re obsessed with the first 20 hours of Warborne Above Ashes, so we cherry-picked March feedback from newbies. Some changes might seem small, but you’ll love them:
The big one? New Driftmasters can pick from 12 Drifters right off the bat, with beginner-friendly recommendations tagged. We want every newcomer to have a deep pool of roles to choose from.
We’ve also tuned progression systems like Mastery, Hypercharge, and Battle Infusion. For instance, Mastery caps now tie to your Driftmaster level. Patch notes will dive deeper, but if you grow smoother this time—free of tech or Tier snags—we’ve done our job.

We’ve tossed in little conveniences too: an anti-stuck feature, easier storage, streamlined Warband management. This is just the beginning!

[h2]In Closing[/h2]

The dev team has been juggling way more over these 40 days, but like this already hefty memo, we can’t cover it all. Still, Warborne Above Ashes isn’t some small-fry project. If you’ve read this far, you can feel our ambition: to forge an eternal post-apocalyptic battlefield.

Thanks for sticking with us. Now, there’s just one thing left—grab your weapon and charge the enemy!

notes.title: 6 Factions in Total War - Warborne New Test Update Content Introduction ②
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome back, Driftmaster:[/b]

Hope you’ve recovered from the last info blast! With the April 24th test ushering in the first total war in Warborne, the breadth and depth of conflict on this chaotic planet are no longer a mere skirmish—you and your Drifters are in for a heap of new content. Remember what you said last time? That’s right, this time we’re rolling out more diverse, more thrilling gameplay experiences!

No more delays—let’s dish out the details. Keeping you waiting isn’t our style!


[h2]Daggers and Treasures: New Changes to Rift Gameplay[/h2]

The treasures of the Edge Sectors aren’t just locked away in Harvester Hubs—beneath the surface, abandoned imperial Rifts still cling to rare resources. In these underground realms where armies can’t tread, Driftmaster will hunt for surprises: precious loot or maybe even a rival Driftmaster...

As one of the standout PvPvE features in Warborne, the Rift gameplay is getting a total overhaul for the April test.

First up, say hello to the brand-new field Rifts. As the Rift owner, you and four teammates will take on bigger, more perilous group Rifts. Naturally, richer rewards await those brave enough to dive in.

Like the old solo Rifts, you can still expose the Rift’s location to snag more powerful weapon blueprints—but this time, your foes are deadlier. Watch out: multiple hostile Driftmasters will band together to infiltrate your Rift, striking when your team’s at its weakest to swipe everything you’ve got.

We thought the original solo Rifts were too “tame.” We wanted an all-out, no-holds-barred fight to the death—so the dangerous Rifts were born.

You won’t have a second to blink. The Rift’s location will be broadcast to all, so brace yourself for the near-certain bloodbath. Let your blade decide if you’re the loser who walks away empty-handed or the victor who claims it all.

[h2]Blood and Glory: A More Complete Veinhold Extraction[/h2]

If the Rifts feel too predictable for your taste, Veinhold Extraction will be right up your alley: snatch treasures in a high-stakes, enemy-filled pressure cooker, then make your escape. In this test, we’re injecting more honor into this mode that Driftmasters can’t get enough of.

Based on your final extraction results, we’ll publicly rank and reward individual participants. Nail an outstanding performance that lands you on the leaderboard, and at settlement, not only will you score personal rewards, but your entire Warband will bask in faction honors for your Veinhold glory. Your actions in the Veinhold will tip the scales of the war!

Plus, for all you Veinhold fanatics, we’re cranking up the frequency of openings: from team-based squad battles on Tuesdays to solo runs on Thursdays and Saturdays. If you live for search-and-extract thrills, you’re free to dive in to your heart’s content.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/aa4c76514117d2e942e9a8b0ef4bdd8680d13111.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/9f301da5deda7e2aae26c2329d3c7e489470ca7f.png[/img]

[h2]All for War: Logistics and Warband Trading System[/h2]

The Total War for the The Forgeheart is set to be a long haul, meaning every faction needs both the charge of warriors and the backbone of logistics. In Warborne’s April test, you’ll get to dive into our trading and logistics systems. We’re making sure they’re just as vital—and that every Driftmaster who pitches in gets equal returns:

●	The shiny new Warband trading system is here. In the Warband culture born from nomadic roots, trading ranks up there with war and plunder. In this test, Warbands of all sizes will forge tighter bonds. Warband managers can issue trade requests from the base and set up transport orders with other Warbands. Heads-up: moving goods requires Driftmaster escorts. Guard your precious cargo well—don’t let any “disruptors” crash the party...
Through steady supply trading, earn currency to grow your Warband. Even the smallest Warband can carve out its piece of the The Forgeheart war!
●	In the fight for strongholds, no one can deny the worth of war machines—and their makers shouldn’t be sidelined. In this test, all logistics-related war gear will earn contribution points when joining the assault. Even if it just soaks up enemy fire, the Driftmaster who crafted it will still score contribution equal to the damage it takes.
●	As a logistics crew, nothing stings more than seeing your Driftmark wrecked on the front lines. That’s why we’ve added Driftmark lockdown mode in this test. Chat with R.A.L.F, wait out a prep period, and your Driftmark will pour all its energy into a shield, making it untouchable—but it’ll lose all combat functions too. The lockdown lifts when the latest war window closes, letting Driftmasters safely funnel resources to their faction without sweating over their prized base.
●	And here’s more: we want non-war times to spark some passion too! Driftmark Defense Turrets will switch to peace mode outside war hours, meaning they won’t attack enemies, but your Driftmark can still heal allies! We’re also urging Driftmasters and Warbands to jump into the fray—deploy sentry bots to guard your turf and keep enemy incursions at bay!


Oh, and one more thing! [url=https://r.qoolandgames.com/war/index]The Warband Pre-Assembly event[/url] bonus pool is inching toward $5,000! And I’m betting more of you will push it even higher. Who hasn’t joined yet? Rally your Warband crew and split the cash!

[url=https://r.qoolandgames.com/war/index ]Pre-create your Warband[/url]

[h2]Total War Is About to Begin![/h2]

The only thing left for you to do is—make sure you’ve clicked [Request Access] and added Warborne to your wishlist!

The wishlist shapes Warborne’s early success, and it means the world to us. We’re beyond grateful for the support of all you Driftmasters!

notes.title: 6 Factions in Total War - Introduction to New Test Updates for Warborne ①
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome back, Driftmaster:[/b]

We’re thrilled to continue sharing our latest changes with you—yes, these will be unveiled on April 24th, but we thought it was time to get your war engines revving a bit early.

In this article, we’ll dive into the new content and improvements coming to Warborne Above Ashes between our test phases. We hate wasting time when there’s so much exciting stuff to cover, so hold onto your reins—let’s get straight to it!

[h2]Total War: New Regions, New Factions[/h2]

As teased in our previous post, Warborne Above Ashes will now showcase our complete war-torn world to all Driftmasters: 6 factions and a fully open world map!
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3142050/view/499444389996658709?l=schinese

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/10f4cedd4e2063d1b91668f200ee5164f3d9c552.png[/img]

While you might already know the details, we’d like to formally introduce the six factions you’ll lead in the battle for the Drift Sectors:

[h3]Emberwild[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/59e72ba606bbb49b36c78cd2e48124ff1b4c8fef.png[/img]
● The Fringe is alive, and Emberwild will burn those who seek to enslave it. Machines and industry have no place here—only flames, fury, and the will of the wild.
    ○ Mounted Warfare – Mounts have increased 5% movement speed.
    ○ Creature Extraction: Deals increased 10% damage to mobs.

[h3]Ashen[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/14b8505329a805f864465b1efbad20b2ce7cf823.png[/img]
● Born from the ashes of a broken world, Ashen bows to no king or warlord. They fight not for power, but for survival—taking what they need, no mercy. Scavengers, rebels, mercenaries—those who refuse to kneel endure in the fire.
    ○ Demolition Experts: Demolisher and siege weapon demolition power increased by 5%
    ○ Extreme Endurance: Maximum health increased by 2.5%

[h3]Sirius[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/e7d742adeb29c5f7bbfdb4b4559092757c41b713.png[/img]
● Masters of knowledge and precision, Sirius believes the future belongs to those who can control it. Their technology dictates the battlefield, where every movement is a calculated step toward victory. Resistance is not defiance—it is error.
    ○ Loot Bonuses: Recovers 5% additional Loot Reward Tokens over time.
    ○ Master Hunters : Deals increased 5% damage to mobs.

[h3]Ironcreed[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/e97ff10227d9488c6cc0864a169e8ee76c427be3.png[/img]
● Discipline is survival. Order is strength. Ironcreed purges weakness, forging the world into something unbreakable—by fire, steel, and war.
    ○ Tech Scientists : 10%Faster research speed for Driftmark technologies.
    ○ Industrialists: Increased 7.5% yields from tech wreckages and trees.

[h3]Shroud[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/a163b446578918ef8ba9ff7caa5c099def8bca21.png[/img]
● They whisper where others shout, moving unseen, striking without warning. Shroud does not wage war—they end all before it begins. In a world of chaos, true power is the blade unseen.
    ○ Skill Slinger: 1.5% Faster skill cooldown speed.
    ○ Night Vision: Additional 5m night vision range.

[h3]Magnates[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/bbdb35e9d9056f6d82a42c9c9f128a093d534a6b.png[/img]
● Power is not given—it is bought, traded, or seized. The Magnates rule not through war, but through wealth—turning soldiers into assets and loyalty into currency.
    ○ Money Moguls: Increased 10% Starfall Token gains from Trading House sales.
    ○ Rising Hunters: Earns 5% more experience from mobs.

Each faction has its own identity and strengths. Find the one that suits your style and join the fierce battle for the The Forgeheart!
Have you decided which side you’re on? For safety, here are a few notes about factions for this test:

● The faction bonuses listed above are not final. During this test, our developers will monitor your performance and adjust the balance dynamically to ensure each faction offers a balanced and fun experience.
● As you can see, resources for early development are limited on the planet (unless you’re taking them from others...), so each server will have a cap on faction population. We strongly recommend choosing a faction with lower Warband congestion to avoid being locked out of the action due to overpopulation.

What? You still want to join the most popular faction?
Then you should check this out:
[url=https://r.qoolandgames.com/war/index]https://r.qoolandgames.com/war/index[/url]

Pre-create your WarbandYes, the Pre-Assembley event for Warborne Above Ashes is live! You and your friends can get a head start by selecting your preferred server and faction for this test. You’ll also earn Eclipsium, name reservation rights, and access to an attractive cash reward pool. The more participants, the richer the rewards—invite all your Warband comrades to join!
For those already participating, you can click [Edit Warband] to change your pre-selected server and faction. Remember: choosing the right faction for your Warband’s growth is crucial. Popular factions face fiercer competition early on, so avoid unnecessary internal strife and focus your energy and resources on the real battlefield—the endless war for the Scorchforged City.

[h2]The First Step to Conquering the Planet: Optimized Driftmark Relocation[/h2]

From the moment you drop onto the planet, your Driftmark is your most vital asset—your home, your mobile fortress, your first strategic spot!We admit, during the March Playtest, relocating the Driftmark was a struggle for some Driftmasters. You’d exhaust all your fuel to reach your ideal map, only to find it overcrowded and unable to deploy... nothing worse than that. We’ve fixed it!

In the upcoming test, we’ve implemented three measures to make Driftmark relocation smoother and more user-friendly:

● During the novice phase, relocating your Driftmark costs no energy, so you can move without anxiety!
● We’ve added a fuel calculation system, allowing you to see exactly how much energy is needed to relocate to each map—no more "energy anxiety."
● Finally, we’ve introduced a [Relocation View] in the world map interface, clearly marking deployable maps in green and showing the number of Driftmarks already stationed there. You can also check this in the relocation preview, ensuring you never make a wasted trip.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/e3044b031c2a774cfad5ce85de86941e65a45bf9.png[/img]

We hope these changes will help all Driftmasters, especially newcomers, develop their strength and that of their Warbands more smoothly, so you can get to the real action faster—Total War!

[h2]All You Need is KILL: New Harvester Hub Mechanics[/h2]

Yes, war! As your Warband and faction grow, the valuable Harvester Hubs in the region will be the focal point of your first conflicts with other forces.In the last test, the Harvester Hub rules were a major concern (yes, we heard your complaints loud and clear!). We’ve completely overhauled them: starting this test, when a Harvester Core is destroyed, we’ll calculate the contribution of each attacking Warband. The Warband with the highest total contribution will be deemed the conqueror and will exclusively claim the armory rewards.

Here’s a table detailing our contribution criteria (note: this is not set in stone!):
● Warband member lands the final blow on the boss: Massive contribution
● Warband member lands the final blow on a guardian: Small contribution
● Warband members cumulatively deal 1% damage to the Harvester Core: Medium contribution
● Warband members cumulatively deal 1% damage to the Harvester Stronghold gate: Small contribution

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/f69f4ba99dd4f22c543985f32c1f15034f10368d.png[/img]

No one can steal your victory anymore—no one. All you need to do is [i][b]slash and kill [/b][/i]with all your might.

[h2]The Final Battle for The Forgeheart: Better Mechanics, More Epic Battlefields[/h2]

After the baptism of Hub wars, you’ll be a battle-hardened Driftmaster, with the thirst for slaughter coursing through your veins. No longer confined to war times, you’ll crave combat, killing, and looting at any moment.To that end, we’ve made significant optimizations to the global map’s queuing system, ensuring smoother entry into this 24/7 "meat grinder" for both sides:

● In map battles, we’ll naturally prioritize factions with strategic needs, but we’ve also reserved space for third-party "wild cards"—welcome to the chaos, and good luck surviving.
● Even outside war times, if a large-scale ZvZ event occurs, we’ll activate a separate set of engagement rules to prevent one-sided slaughters in wildly imbalanced encounters.
● Legion Rank is no longer a barrier to war! Based on your feedback from the last test, we’ve replaced Legion Rank with Power to determine battlefield entry priority. If you’re strong enough, you’ll get into the fiercest battles faster—and face stronger enemies. But we know you’ll love it.

[h2]It's that ALL？[/h2]

This 30-day Total War will test every Driftmaster’s deployment and understanding of the battlefield. Develop your resources, upgrade your gear, and through the baptism of fire and blood, delve deeper into the planet’s core to uncover its secrets.

On April 24th, we can’t wait to see every Driftmaster in action—make sure to click [Request Access] and add us to your wishlist (it’s crucial for us). Join this feast of war!

But wait, there’s more! We’ll be releasing further details in the coming days, so don’t forget to join our Discord for the latest updates. See you on the battlefield:

[b]Over 52,883 Driftmasters hailing from 128 regions,[/b] joined us in this first Playtest — thank you for making this playtest a true success!
