And just when we thought we'd seen it all.. when we noticed our Steam Wishlist soaring by nearly 2,000 at late night 3am.. there was only one thought on our minds: “OMG… this is completely beyond our wildest expectations...”
[b]
Thank you so much, Driftmasters. Your passion is the fuel that drives us forward. We'll keep pushing to make Warborne Above Ashes even better.
[/b]
Of course, since we're on the topic of improvements, let's address the issues we've encountered so far:

[h2]Feedback and Key Concerns:[/h2]
We've picked several questions that everyone is particularly concerned about during this Playtest—do note that we are also closely monitoring the various other issues you've raised and are actively working to address them.

[list]
[*] [b]“"Faction is full, unable to create character", "Unable to deploy Driftmark"[/b]
We are aware of this issue and are implementing measures to ensure that all Driftmasters will be able to join the battlefield. This is our number one priority.

There will be 6 factions available this time in the upcoming Playtest in April, which provides for further  options and territories to conquer!

Additionally, we will closely monitor the number of players in each server and faction, and will be actively clearing out inactive accounts and AFK players to make space for those who are looking to join the fight for ATHAS!

We acknowledge that there is a physical cap to a planet's capacity, but the fires of War have never been confined to just a single planet in Warborne Above Ashes —we will consider adding new servers should the need arise.

[*][b] Balance issues regarding some Drifters and weapons[/b]

We've heard the feedback from the community loud and clear—"Shadowseer OP", "Healers are too weak". We've already added them into our to-do list. We will be analyzing the data we've obtained from the Playtest and will be using that to make the necessary balance adjustments. 

Do note that this is an ongoing process, we appreciate your patience on this matter: We believe you won't be disappointed with the final results!

[*][b]  Map Queue Optimization [/b]
“Abruptly kicked out mid-game?!” “I really want to join the fight on this map!” These are serious issues repeatedly raised by players during this test. We are still exploring ways to improve the Map Queue system within server capacity constraints, to ensure every player is able to experience the thrill of battle. We humbly welcome your suggestions on Discord and will be taking inspiration from your ideas to find the best possible solutions—no time to waste on the way to the frontlines!

[*][b]Harvester Hub Occupation Rules[/b]
We’ve always believed that every deserving effort deserves a corresponding reward. Going forward, Harvester Hub ownership will be determined by Warband contribution. Let each interwoven hub cumulate into a symphony of iron and blood — forged by the struggles of every Warband!
[/list]

[h2]Words of Encouragement[/h2]

Despite the issues that surfaced during the test, the positive feedback and encouragement received from all of you is the best possible fuel for our team’s “War Engine”. [b]Every word drives us forward![/b]

[b]Marobi:[/b] As a MMO player, the thing that we are looking for in this game is 24/7 small/mid/large scale battles all the time without spending to much time gathering resources to be able to max everything out. 

[b]Shadeless: [/b]I think the Faction & Warband parts are fantastic, the competitive nature of the game starts from the first kill and doesn't stop. The Social aspect is enjoyable as well, randomly finding people in Zones who assist you or vice versa. 

[i]Yes! This is Warborne — 24/7,  non-stop battles that you just can’t stop![/i]

[b]ABigBanana：[/b]The game has high potential for growth and is easy to pick up. Its blend of MOBA, PVP, and SLG elements forges a brand-new path — bringing a unique and innovative experience!

[b]Prexualsedator: [/b]Core mecahnics look fun. I like to flex into every role if that means I can make group content work.

[i]Driftmasters, thank you for defining Warborne with us: land and fight — and most importantly, take charge and lead the war![/i]

[b]Syndic: [/b]The game is amazing and everyone in my community loves it out of it and we're super sad the playtest is over.

[b]Shukakah: [/b]Thank you for a good gaming experience till now,  i have enjoyed playing the play test alot, i do wish to see more, and hopefully this becomes a good game.

[i]Still itching for more action? Fret not — we’ll be bringing you new maps for six factions to explore in April! Stay alert, Driftmaster — the next battle is just around the corner![/i]

Lastly, we believe it’s time to reward your passion for battle with a glimpse of what’s to come — the next call to war!

[h2]Battle Preview: April Faction Test Incoming[/h2]

Many of you may have already heard the rumors, but let's make it official — we are preparing a full-scale Six-Faction Map Test at the end of April. Expect larger, fiercer wars than ever before!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/0108a72997cdc0017f8b4febe7cef980cf6d4dbe.png[/img]

[list]
[*]The six factions are far more than simple copies — each is truly unique: Ashen, Sirius, Emberwild, Magnates, Ironcreed and Shroud.
You’ll gain exclusive Traits from your chosen faction and enter the battlefield carrying its legacy into every fight.
[b]Here’s what you might need to know:[/b]
Trust me — they’ll create far more fascinating experiences than you could ever imagine! But stay focused on your ultimate objective: no matter which faction you fight for, all will devote everything they have to the battle for supremacy over The Forgeheart!

[*][b]Full-Scale Upgrades[/b]
Driftmasters, the battlefield is no longer a mere skirmish — expect larger battlefields, more allies and enemies, and deeper strategic choices.
By the end of April, you’ll step onto Warborne Above Ashes’s true stage: epic wars with thousands of other players, diplomatic engagements and struggles, and a sophisticated faction ecosystem.
The grand theater of the path to planetary domination is about to unfold before your very eyes!

[*]I think this is a common consensus among Driftmasters this past Playtest: way too short of a time to get my fill of the action. 

However, this time..! There'll be 30 days and nights of battle to set the planet ablaze in the war for supremacy and dominance!

Still, this is merely the beginning. This one month is just the first act of this epic War Saga. With each passing cycle, new chapters will unfold, adding to the War Saga that shall echo across the Ages. Diverse content and stories await your discovery as the War Saga progresses!

We've heard your feedback regarding small-scale PvP content and new player tutorial optimization, and have added these and other issues into our dev schedule! We are also in the midst of preparing more new gameplay and content for everyone to experience. Please stay tuned for what's coming!

The March Playtest has come to a close, but this is not the end; it's not even the beginning of the end. It's merely the end of the beginning—our journey on the path of war has only taken a small step so far.

notes.title: 🔥The player test on March 15 is waiting for you to join the battle!
notes.notes:
[b]Thank You, Driftmasters![/b]

Even in just two brief test phases, your passion for war has ignited the entire Fringe Sector—and us as well. Watching from the sidelines was enough to get our blood pumping!

We have to admit, participation far exceeded our most optimistic expectations. Over [b]700 players[/b] and more than [b]10 Warbands[/b] joined the technical test, making history as the first to wage war across the sector. And no, we’re not exaggerating—you fought battle after battle on an epic scale!

As we reviewed these tests, we were stunned by how quickly you adapted to Warborne. Our initial design included a three-hour familiarization period, but you barely needed a moment—mastering Builds, War Vehicles, and combat mechanics in no time.

What truly shocked us, though, was your unrelenting battle spirit. Our original plan was for most of the fighting to take place at Wretchwater Bastion, but you had other plans. Instead of waiting, many of you marched straight from your territory, circumventing the contested fortress, and launched long-range expeditions deep into enemy land—pulling off a massive raid that was nothing short of a textbook nomadic war campaign.

You became the nomads of Roguelands—natural raiders and conquerors. This is exactly what this world was made for.

And this is only the beginning.

[h3]Stay tuned, Driftmasters. Bigger wars are coming.[/h3]

[h2]Minimal Lag—We Did It![/h2]
The most unforgettable part of these two technical tests? Massive 100-player battles with minimal lag!That’s right—our servers held strong, letting everyone experience smooth, fluid combat. Some players even reported 200+ms ping, yet they were still able to pilot massive war beasts and smash their enemies to pieces—flawlessly.

[h2]More Updates On the Way![/h2]
Every piece of feedback you’ve given us reflects your passion for Warborne, and we deeply appreciate the trust and support behind it. We've distilled your feedback into three key areas (though, of course, there’s much more—we’ve also been actively improving combat mechanics based on your input!):

[b]● UI Optimization:[/b]We know there’s plenty of room for improvement, especially in how icons impact PvP visibility. Rest assured—we’re working on a solution that will meet your expectations.

[b]● Queue System:[/b]This is war, not a spectator event. We’ll be making sure that everyone in the queue is actually part of the fight—no bystanders, only warriors.

[b]● Respawn Experience:[/b]Nobody likes having to re-equip everything after dying. As hardcore PvP players ourselves, we get it. This is already on our to-do list, and we won’t keep you waiting long!

[h2]March 15 Test—What's in Store for You?[/h2]
By now, you probably already know—but let me say it again: on March 15, Warborne Above Ashes officially launches its first test! The tribal wars of the Fringe Sector will erupt in full force, and compared to what’s coming, the past technical tests will seem like child's play.

Prepare to step into a vast world, engage in larger battles, and most importantly, fight alongside more allies—or face more enemies waiting in the shadows, ready to slit your throat. A new world awaits your conquest, Driftmasters.

See you on March 15!

notes.title: A letter from the Warborne Above Ashes development team
notes.notes:
Hello！I am ShuiGe, the producer of Warborne Above Ashes! It’s great to meet you all!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/29a8004718ade336833e0ff8c60915667ada47d8.jpg[/img]

Our team consists of long-time, passionate MMORPG and PVP fans. Over these years, we’ve spent countless hours on the battlefields - from intense battles in narrow valleys to prolonged sieges over castles and keeps. These experiences still excite us to this day, and we can't wait to share that excitement with all of you. Our goal is to create a world where PvP battles are always just around the corner, and you’ll be ready to rise to the challenge whenever it comes your way.

  In Warborne, you will take on the role of a Driftmaster, commander of a fleet of space nomads, leading your faction to survive and thrive on a mysterious and resource-rich planet. You will compete with thousands of players for "Exergy" - a vital and valuable resource found on the planet. This contest will ignite a neverending war and you will fight alongside allies to establish dominance on this world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/5e8c08416be7ca549bdb9bc5a57368ad48f958bb.jpg[/img]

[b]-Design Philosophy[/b]
We’re incredibly excited to share Warborne with you, and we want to give you a sneak peek at some of the core ideas behind our design.

[b]1.PVP Anytime, Anywhere: [/b]
  We don’t want battles to be locked behind rigid rules or specific scenarios. Instead, we want players to be able to jump into massive battles whenever they’re up for it. In Warborne, you can initiate large-scale fights at any time and place, the thrill of combat lies at every corner! We have designed a simple and intuitive combat system that ensures you can dive into the action quickly and enjoy the excitement of PvP with ease!

[b]2.Combining Strategy and Tactics: [/b]
  "Winning the war means outsmarting your enemies, not just overpowering them." 
  In Warborne, strategy and action go hand in hand. Raw skill alone won’t win the fight—you’ll need to coordinate with your teammates and use clever tactics to outsmart your enemies. Here’s a look at some of the features at your disposal:
    • Tactical Support: Deploy lightning defence towers, summon robots to fight in your name and use a variety of tools to shift the battlefield in your favor.
    • Siege Vehicles: Utilise high-tech siege vehicles to break through enemy defenses.
    • Logistics & Transport: Plan and fight over supply lines—these are key to victory.
  These features ensure that each battle is more than just about individual skill. It’s about how well your faction can think on their feet and work together to turn the tide. A single clever move can change everything.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/23692ff4bab5a69043d0ec0ac028032d3fc34ea7.jpg[/img]

[b]3.No Victory is guaranteed:[/b]
  In many traditional PvP games, some factions can build an unstoppable momentum, leading to a “snowball effect” where the winner just keeps winning. That's something we want to avoid in Warborne. That’s why we’ve implemented a seasonal reset system. After every season, the battlefield is reset, and everyone starts afresh. This ensures the game stays fair, and every player—new or experienced—gets a chance to find new challenges and opportunities every season.

[b]4.Diverse Builds & Combinations: [/b]
  We want you to be able to play the role that you like best. That’s why we’ve designed over 40 unique Drifters, each with their own special abilities and roles. Whether you’re a warrior, an assassin, a sniper, or a support player, there’s a Drifter for every playstyle.
    • Variety of roles: Play as a warrior, assassin, sniper, support and more.  Showcase your abilities on the battlefield!
    • Diverse combinations: Over 80 weapons and 30 types of armor, each with unique abilities, giving you the freedom to create your perfect loadout.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374458/3c123122e9e92f0c50a1d64114521c2ddb2093a0.jpg[/img]

[b]-What We’ve Learned So Far[/b]
  We conducted a small-scale player test earlier this year, and are thrilled to have received positive feedback on our PvP warfare experience. We saw intense battles between rival factions, observed brilliant siege tactics, and witnessed mass base migrations in the race for Exergy control. This is the PvP warfare experience we've always aimed for!
  
During the test, we identified some areas that need improvement. Our current focus is on making the seasonal mechanics more interesting and engaging, such as adding seasonal content and refining the reset mechanics.
  
We also received valuable feedback from many players who have expressed a desire for more PvE content and logistics options outside of combat. We take this feedback seriously and plan to add more PvE dungeon challenges and unique gameplay for players who prefer support roles, such as logistics, transportation, resource collection and management. We want every player to find their place in Warborne, whether you’re a frontline fighter or a strategic support expert.

[b]-What’s Next?[/b]
  Our goal is to create a PvP-centric, war-themed MMORPG that stands out among the many great titles in our genre. The development of Warborne Above Ashes is progressing at full speed and we plan to conduct a large-scale test in the first quarter of 2025. We’d love for you to join us and provide us with your invaluable feedback!
  Every suggestion, every piece of feedback, helps us improve Warborne and bring you a better experience!

Thank you for your support,
The Warborne Above Ashes Development Team
